description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for Orleans transactions using xUnit, extending a base test runner to include test methods decorated with [SkippableTheory], which are parameterized with data related to transactional grains and transaction counts.

classes.name: GoldenPathTransactionTestRunnerxUnit
classes.description: An abstract class extending GoldenPathTransactionTestRunner to provide xUnit-specific test method implementations with parameterized data and skip logic.

methods.name: SingleGrainReadTransaction
methods.description: Overrides base method to run read transactions on a single grain with specific test data, skipping as per specified condition.

methods.name: SingleGrainWriteTransaction
methods.description: Overrides base method to run write transactions on a single grain with specific test data, skipping as per specified condition.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransaction
methods.description: Overrides base method to run write transactions involving multiple grains, with different grain counts.

methods.name: MultiGrainReadWriteTransaction
methods.description: Overrides base method to run mixed read/write transactions across multiple grains.

methods.name: RepeatGrainReadWriteTransaction
methods.description: Overrides base method to run repeated read/write transactions across grains.

methods.name: MultiWriteToSingleGrainTransaction
methods.description: Overrides base method to test multiple write transactions to a single grain.

methods.name: RWRWTest
methods.description: Overrides base method to perform read-write-read-write transaction testing.

methods.name: WRWRTest
methods.description: Overrides base method to perform write-read-write-read transaction testing.
